text_block_list.text:
To be completely honest, I didn't know if I had what it takes
to lead her to victory in the Twinkle Series. But... even so!
choice_data_list: I want to be your Trainer.
I want to be your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie!! 'O sole mio!!!
Ah, what a truly marvelous day—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, pardon. Let us avoid prestissimo.
This is a crucial passage. I must strive for meno mosso.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
May I ask you just one thing?
—Why me?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! Compared to the other angeli, I play rubato,
quite difficult to handle, no? So, why choose me?

Her careful response made it clear. To form a contract with her,
this answer would be crucial. Cheap words simply wouldn't do.

Yet, I couldn't find the right words.
Even though I want to train her so badly...!

Her explosive stretch run. The captivating way she enjoyed running.
Her brilliant, sun-like demeanor—it was all true, but not enough.
Ordinary words could never fully express this passion...!
choice_data_list: Your running made me... wait, no—ah!
Your running made me... wait, no—ah!

text_block_list.text:
Just then, the maraca in my bag gave a sharp rattle. I had
forgotten to return it yesterday, planning to hand it back when we met.

...That's it. If words aren't enough,
I should use the method that will reach her most without them!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? What is the matter, Trainer?
Isn't that the—
(Chaka! Chaka-chaka-chaka!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hm...? ...Ah, I see.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: More passionate than salsa.

I shake the maracas with all my heart, praying it reaches her.
She was the one who broadened my once-narrow horizons.

She reminded me of the pure joy of racing!
"That's why I want to see you out there on the turf—"
choice_data_list: (Giving the greatest performance of your life!)

text_block_list.text:
She reminded me of the pure joy of racing!
"That's why I want to see you out there on the turf—"
choice_data_list: (Giving the greatest performance of your life!)

text_block_list.text:
Pouring all those feelings into the rhythm,
I just keep shaking the maracas with everything I have—

How long had I been shaking them...?
Just as I pause out of sheer exhaustion—applause rings out.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Braviiiiiissimo!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This is it! The musica I have sought in a Trainer!!
Ah... ahh! You truly are my destiny!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Yes, what I desire is—the ultimate session!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The finest horsegirls, the finest stage, the finest races... and beyond
that, a grandioso session! That is the very reason I run!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...And you understood that.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No words were needed. You knew that playing it was enough.
The moment you understood that, everything became clear.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now, take my hand.

Sounds of Earth offers her hand, and I take it.
At long last, it feels as though we've reached the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
From this day forth, you are my direttore!
Together, let us perform our melodia to the ends of the earth!!
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll do my best as your direttore!
Yeah! I'll do my best as your direttrice!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
From this day forth, you are my direttrice!
Together, let us perform our melodia to the ends of the earth!!
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll do my best as your direttore!
Yeah! I'll do my best as your direttrice!

text_block_list.text:
I shout back in rhythm with her. ...Though I couldn't help
wondering what "direttore" actually meant.

I shout back in rhythm with her. ...Though I couldn't help
wondering what "direttrice" actually meant.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Shall we begin moderato?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And then, I would like to change this mezzo forte in the fourth
measure to fortissimo. It would resonate so much better, no?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Then let our étude begin.
—Uno, due, tre, quattro!

The next day. My first duty as Sounds of Earth's Trainer was
not physical training—it was ensemble practice.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You see, in two weeks, our session... a mock race awaits.
Thus, we must achieve armonia without delay!

...I wondered if we shouldn't be running instead, but I understood
that this was her way of deepening our bond, so—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Calmly, direttore.
We are not at the accelerando just yet.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Calmly, direttrice.
We are not at the accelerando just yet.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mind the a tempo.
I know you can do it! Comodo!
choice_data_list: (I-I have no idea what she's saying...!)

text_block_list.text:
I felt embarrassed for thinking I understood Sounds of Earth.
In truth, her sharp intuition had simply read me.

As anxiety crept in over whether I could truly be her direttore
(conductor)—

As anxiety crept in over whether I could truly be her direttrice
(conductor)—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. There is no need to rush, Trainer.
Largo... slowly, let us fill the musical staff together.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Our prelude has only just begun!
